boards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: detailed concept review board for an ORIGINAL Godot 2D top-down cultivation game, not an import-ready sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is a CHARACTER IDENTITY AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY: keep the recognizable cultivator's black swept fringe, topknot, large expressive ink eyes, jade crossover robe, ivory collar, cloth belt, bronze sword fittings and dark boots. Develop that same character rather than replace him.
Style/medium: Don’t Starve Together inspired hand-drawn 2D cutout illustration: confident irregular warm-black ink contours, flat muted colors, selective short hatching, subtle dry brush accents. Original wuxia characters, no copied Klei characters or logos. Cleaner controlled silhouette than rough scribbles. Fine detail belongs inside large shapes; no fuzzy edges, blurry rendering, photorealism, 3D shading or neon glow.
Scene/backdrop: uncluttered warm ivory paper, light grain, only thin ink dividers and short readable headings; generous whitespace around complete figures.
Constraints: full hands and feet, anatomically intelligible elbows and knees, consistent face and outfit across poses, compact chibi adult hero around three heads tall. Side view shows one natural eye and a real profile nose/ear; back view has no eyes on back of head. Same grounded feet scale, no giant feet. This is an art proposal awaiting review, not a finished animation or a game screenshot.
Primary request: develop a precise two-sex eight-facing character turnaround. Landscape review board with EXACTLY TWO ROWS OF EIGHT FULL-BODY FIGURES at a consistent scale. Top row male, bottom row female. Both wear the same jade martial robe, belt, ivory underlayer, boots, with empty relaxed hands so all anatomy is visible. Female has a distinct softer face, slightly narrower shoulders and tied hair, the same heroic proportions and practical clothing; she must be an authored body, not a stretched male or a sexualized costume.
Column facing order as seen by the camera, precisely: SOUTH front facing viewer; SOUTH-WEST three-quarter facing page left toward viewer; WEST TRUE PROFILE facing left; NORTH-WEST rear three-quarter facing left away; NORTH exact back; NORTH-EAST rear three-quarter facing right away; EAST TRUE PROFILE facing right; SOUTH-EAST three-quarter facing right toward viewer.
All figures are standing neutrally with feet on a common baseline per row, mild top-down perspective: top of head and shoulders slightly visible. Keep far eye occluded in true profile, both eyes fully absent in all rear poses, hair orientation genuinely redrawn. Exact short labels: title "CHARACTER • 8 DIRECTIONS"; rows "MALE" and "FEMALE"; columns "S", "SW", "W", "NW", "N", "NE", "E", "SE". No extra portraits, arrows, alternate characters or scenery. prioritize correct directions and coherent silhouettes over decorative flourishes.

Primary request: create a coherent original spell concept board in the SAME ink-and-paper visual grammar, replacing the overly bright cyan icons in the previous concept. No characters necessary.
Layout: four spacious horizontal rows, each has four columns: a large hand-drawn square UI icon on parchment with ragged warm-black outline, a compact cast gesture VFX, a readable main effect, and a compact impact/end effect. Header "GU SKILLS • INK & PAPER"; column captions "ICON", "CAST", "EFFECT", "END". Four rows named exactly "NGUYET QUANG", "BACH NGOC", "BACH HAC", "BANG TAM".
Row 1 Moon blade: jade/ivory crescent with elegant dry-ink edge; tiny crescent gather, one thin flying moon blade with limited stippled trail, a crisp broken crescent ink impact. No luminous giant circle.
Row 2 White jade shield: ivory jade plate emblem with tiny warm ochre inset; small ink sigil rising, a HOLLOW asymmetrical protective ivory/jade oval ring with sparse carved marks, three paperlike shards as it ends. Preserve clear empty central space.
Row 3 White crane dash: warm ivory feather emblem with dusty slate vein; curled feather cast, two airy speed strokes and three restrained feathers along a directional dash, tiny ink landing puff. No laser streaks or duplicated glowing bodies.
Row 4 Ice silkworm: small stylized ivory silkworm curled beside an angular slate-blue frost shard; frost curl gathering, a matte slate/ivory angular projectile, compact three-shard chill burst with small ground frost marks.
Keep each skill legible by shape in monochrome as well as muted color. Palette warm black #29251f, ivory #eee0be, jade #73816c, dusty slate #7c8c94, ochre #ae8952. No saturated blue, cyan aura, bloom, shiny gradient, realistic particles, photographic fire, science fiction magic, glossy mobile-game button. Shape vocabulary connects insects/cultivation to dry drawn marks. Fewer better marks, never scribble clouds. These are icon/VFX design studies, no cooldown values, costs or gameplay alterations.

Landscape art board, top half contains six FULL-BODY dressed looks in a single row: male jade/sword/topknot/cloth boots/no hat; female jade/sword/ponytail/cloth boots/no hat; male crimson/spear/topknot/leather boots/cloth cap; female crimson/spear/ponytail/leather boots/cloth cap; male ivory/unarmed/topknot/cloth boots/straw conical hat; female ivory/unarmed/ponytail/leather boots/straw conical hat. All parts are clearly separated with generous spacing rather than overlapping a messy stack; subtle dotted leader lines lead to small attachment points on a faint central neutral silhouette. Thin lines are annotations, not visible bones in finished costume.
Short exact headings "MODULAR WARDROBE", "JADE", "CRIMSON", "IVORY", "BODY", "HAIR", "HAT", "ROBE", "BOOTS", "WEAPON". Clothing is not just recolored: crimson has angular edging and ivory has layered light fabric, but all retain original cultivator silhouette. This is an exploded DESIGN board, not ready-cut production assets or invented gameplay equipment stats.

Primary request: a readable animation KEYFRAME study for the SAME jade male cultivator, full-body TRUE SIDE VIEW facing right consistently. EXACTLY TWO HORIZONTAL ROWS of EIGHT full-body figures: WALK top row, RUN bottom row. Header "LOCOMOTION • KEYFRAME STUDY". Small captions "01" to "08" per row. No facial portraits or other poses.
Each row shows an ordered complete stride cycle with genuinely different foot and limb positions: left contact, left loading/down, right passing, right up/swing, right contact, right loading/down, left passing, left up/swing. Far limbs remain subtly darker but distinct. Arm motion opposes legs, elbows articulate naturally; walking arm bend relaxed; running elbows bent with shoulders moving. Hands empty in this study, sword absent. WALK always has at least one planted foot, heel-to-toe roll, restrained head bob and mild upright torso. RUN has wider stride, brief both-feet-off-ground flight, modest forward body lean, larger knee flex, cloth/hair lag trailing behind direction of movement. Keep eyes, head, torso, footwear size and hair knot identity consistent across all 16 drawings; true profile has a single visible eye. A thin ground baseline under each row; small planted-foot ticks, no long dust clouds, no ground arrows under every foot.
This must look like an animator's sequential pose study with meaningful contrast between walk and run, not 16 copies of one running pose. End frame returns toward first without duplicating first. It is a concept keyframe board; no claim of actual animated playback.

Primary request: a combat/action keyframe board with EXACTLY FOUR ROWS of FOUR full-body figures, consistent side/three-quarter view facing right, sensible scale and complete weapons. Title "ACTIONS • KEYFRAME STUDY". Four columns short exact names "READY", "WINDUP", "RELEASE", "RECOVER". Row 1 "SWORD": male jade swordsman, a relaxed ready grip, clear sword drawn back with wrist on hilt, decisive forward crescent slash, recovery returning blade. Sword blade must remain rigid and originate from the right-hand grip, never independent of the hand.
Row 2 "SPEAR": female jade cultivator, ready two-handed spear, compact rear windup, straight two-handed forward thrust, recovery. Support hand remains attached to shaft; both elbows bend plausibly, full spear remains visible.
Row 3 "CAST": male unarmed jade cultivator, neutral, hand gathering tiny ink/jade crescent, arm releasing one moon blade, relaxed recovery. Keep tiny crescent distinctly away from face, no explosive neon bloom.
Row 4 "GUARD": female jade sword user, ready, raising blade defensively with free forearm protecting torso, a firm blocking pose with restrained impact ticks near blade, recovery. Female retains practical robe and recognizable softly drawn face, not exaggerated curves.
Very small controlled ink strokes convey motion/contact, silhouettes and weapon grip take priority. Distinct poses per phase; avoid every phase looking like the same crouching slash. Paper background and hair/cloth/ribbon lag as in reference. This is a proposed pose sequence, not real-time animation or gameplay damage logic.
